title: Hearth-Ruin Behemoth
text: Hearth-Ruin Behemoth tears open dead furnaces and wears their burning plates as a moving throne. On loss, suffer 2 Wounds.
flavor: The Court calls it royal because nothing else survives nearby.

defeatReward.text: Hearth-Ruin Behemoth is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
